WITH behavior_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) as transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(transaction_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_types
  FROM behavior_transactions
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    bt.tradekind,
    bt.transaction_count,
    bt.transaction_count::numeric / t.total_count as share,
    1::numeric / t.num_types as avg_share,
    t.num_types
  FROM behavior_transactions bt
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  transaction_count as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as share_minus_avg
FROM with_shares
WHERE num_types > 0
  AND share > avg_share
ORDER BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in trader.tradekind are included as a distinct group in the aggregation, as indicated by 'with a missing type as its own group'
